description: SLS builds LED walls, lighting rigs and PA systems to order for event companies and venues in Greece. Made to order in two to five weeks.

title: The three ranges
description: LED walls indoors and out, moving-head lighting on DMX-512, line-array sound. Six models, each with its figures and its lead time.

title: Catalogue
description: Six models with their pitch, brightness, output and lead time. Prices open once a trade account is approved.

title: How an order runs
description: Apply, order, then pay half when SLS accepts and the balance when the job is finished. Two to five weeks to build.

title: About SLS
description: What SLS sells, who it sells to and how an order is priced. A Greek supplier of screens, lighting and sound for events.

title: Apply for trade pricing
description: Apply with your company name and VAT number. Once the account is approved, every price in the catalogue is visible.

title: Contact
description: The venue, the date and what the job has to do. Send those three and SLS comes back with a specification and a price.

title: Privacy policy
description: What personal data SLS holds, why, how long for, and how to ask for a copy or its deletion.

title: Cookies and storage
description: SLS sets no advertising or analytics cookies. What the site stores in your browser, and why it is necessary.

title: Terms of supply
description: The terms on which SLS prices, supplies, delivers and invoices equipment and services.
